title: A hollow of known volume under rain
process: a street hollow filling from its catchment, spilling at its rim, and standing at the rim afterwards
executor: node (CPU surface solver) and browser (GPU); raw measurements in street/raw/, scored by run.mjs
equations: before it spills: depth = P A_c / A_h (P rain depth, A_c catchment, A_h hollow floor)
once P A_c exceeds the hollow's volume A_h d: it spills; at rest the water stands at the rim, depth d, whatever the storm
spilled volume = P A_c - A_h d; edge outflow = spilled + P x (the ground below the rim)
peak head over the rim at steady spill: H = 1.5 (q^2/g)^(1/3), q = i A_c / W (critical flow over a broad crest, no friction)
boundaryConditions: walls on three sides; free-outfall edge at the east end, below the rim
geometry: a 60 x 10 m street: 30 m falling east at 2 %, a level-floored hollow 10 m long sunk 0.20 m below its rim (100 m^2, 20 m^3), a level rim 1 m long that takes no rain, then 19 m falling east at 2 %; n 0.015; 1 m cells. Catchment of the hollow: 400 m^2.

cases.unit: rain mm/h and min; times s

solver: FloodSim surface solver with the app's settings (hdry 1e-5 m, hfront 1e-3 m, dtDry 2 s; MUSCL minmod, HLLC, SSP-RK2, CFL 0.48). cpu rows: src/solver-cpu.js (fp64). gpu rows: src/solver-gpu.js in Chrome WebGPU (fp32).

reference.sources: conservation of volume; Henderson (1966) sec. 6.6 for critical flow over a broad crest
reference.independence: arithmetic on the rain depth and the geometry
reference.crossCheck: refs.test.mjs: level for a volume by bisection and from the sorted beds; the rim head has Froude 1 at the crest

outputs: depth in the hollow at the end (mean over its floor)
spilled volume (edge outflow less the rain that fell below the rim)
peak depth in the hollow (highest sampled mean, every 60 s)
the same end depth for a storm twice as large (SS2-c against SS2-b)
criteriaNotes: 3 mm on the end depth: the film still draining down the street and over the rim at the end. 8 mm on the peak: the reference has no friction on the rim, and the peak is sampled each minute. Spill volume: 2 % or 0.3 m^3.
conservation: surface books: stored = rain - edge outflow
assumptions: the rim cell takes no rain, so the catchment is exact
limitations: a level floor and a straight rim: a real hollow's storage curve comes from the DEM
peak head: the reference is frictionless critical flow
validRange: hollows a few cells or more across at 1 m; storms from below to several times the hollow's volume
scoring: automated: street/score.mjs builds rows with lib/score.mjs row(); one row set per executor (cpu, gpu), never merged; a case with no raw file is listed as not run and has no rows

criteriaRevisions.why: first registration, before any sandbox case was run
